title: OL-20261118-3: After 00:00 UTC confirm watchdog lands via main-writer
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** 00:00 UTC D1 reset
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation drainwatch
**Status:** closed

Confirm the next watchdog run succeeds and open PRs trend to 0 after the D1 reset.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 70.7 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
